gates.required_evidence: Signed iPhone app starts JVM after debugger disconnect and relaunch, without JIT or jailbreak.
Locked engine loads on device; actual E4X and Java interop calls prove required XML/beans classes work.
Original semantics cases pass on the iOS JVM including this/eval/Function/scope/E4X/Java wrapping/overloads.
On-device reference comparison covers search/details/TOC/content, pure JS, login and batch content, including requests and state effects.
On-device cancellation, timeout, browser cancellation, isolation and repeated-run results with measured performance.
